description: Goal-driven deep research: grill-to-goal scoping, parallel web plus paper divers, white-paper HTML reports.

defaultPrompt: Research this topic thoroughly with cited sources.
Compare methods across recent arXiv papers on this topic.
Give me a cited report with gaps explicitly listed.
interface.longDescription: Grills the user to a shared research brief, fans out parallel DuckDuckGo web and arXiv paper divers, verifies every claim against primary sources, iterates gaps until coverage saturation, and delivers a cited Markdown report.
interface.shortDescription: Deep research with grill-to-brief scoping and cited reports.

name: deep-research
